title: Keypresses inside Ruffle (Test Movie + Live Preview) leak to the stage (arrow keys nudge shapes / switch tools / trigger reload)
description: BUG: when interacting with the running SWF in Ruffle Test Movie AND the Live Preview tab, keyboard input leaks to the authoring app: arrow keys nudge selected stage shapes, letter keys switch tools, and keys can trigger preview reloads. The SWF should receive the keys; the authoring global shortcuts/nudge must NOT fire while the player is focused/active. EXPLORE: the global keyboard handler(s) for the editor — tool shortcut hotkeys + arrow-key nudge of selected objects (likely document-level keydown listeners in Shell.tsx or a hotkeys/useKeyboard module + StageArea nudge handler), the Test Movie modal (useExportHandlers / its player host), the Live Preview panel (preview/LivePreviewPanel.tsx), and packages/player/RufflePlayer.tsx (focus + how it receives keys). FIX: ensure keyboard events while focus is within a Ruffle player (Test Movie modal or Live Preview) do NOT reach the authoring shortcuts/nudge/reload. Robust approach: the authoring global key handlers should ignore events whose target is inside a ruffle-player / Test Movie modal / Live Preview container (check event.target/activeElement containment, or a 'player has focus' flag), AND/OR the player container stops propagation of key events to the document while keeping them delivered to Ruffle. Make sure the SWF still gets keyboard input (Key.isDown etc. work) and that Escape/close still works for Test Movie. Apply to BOTH Test Movie and Live Preview. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable). Add a test/e2e: with the Live Preview (or Test Movie) focused, an arrow key / tool-shortcut key does NOT move a selected stage shape or switch the active tool (and ideally the SWF still receives the key). Update docs if relevant. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: global key handler(s) + RufflePlayer/Test-Movie/Live-Preview focus handling (+test). Disjoint from the vector re-architecture tasks.
